iOSReviewNotes:
Scriptum is a native Markdown editor for iPhone and iPad. No Scriptum account or sign-in is required for local writing, organization or export.

Start: choose "Spaces und Bibliothek öffnen". Build 10 now opens the page list first. Create or open a page to write. Formatting, undo/redo, comments, replies, saved revisions and export are available from the editor.

iCloud is optional: use the cloud toolbar button in the page list, or More > iCloud-Synchronisation while editing, then iCloud aktivieren. This uses the system iCloud account and CloudKit private/shared databases. There is no separate synchronization server or Scriptum account. Local writing works without iCloud. Account/service availability is checked at runtime; the Diagnose section shows bounded error codes without document or account contents. A previous tester report showed a local synchronization-storage error; this build corrects reproduced transport-file capacity failures and preserves the original callback diagnosis. It does not claim to fix every device account or service condition.

Optional AI: choose KI / KI-Zugang in the editor. The context identifies the selection, paragraph or whole page and selected recipient before sending. Apple Private Cloud Compute, OpenAI/Anthropic API keys and ChatGPT sign-in require the respective provider/device/account/region eligibility; none is required for local writing or export.

Build 10 replaces build 9 with the library-entry correction, direct iCloud access, batched durable sync writes/receipts and safe diagnostics. No advertising or tracking SDK. Experimental native multilingual rule-engine research is not included or claimed as a feature.
macOSReviewNotes:
Scriptum is a native macOS Markdown editor, not an iPad/Catalyst application. No Scriptum account or sign-in is required for local writing, organization or export.

Open or create a page in the library. Native text editing, formatting, undo/redo, comments/replies, revisions, templates, outline/links, tables, attachments and export are available from the workspace and Bibliothek menu. PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, ePub and blog output use theme-based previews.

iCloud is optional: choose iCloud in the library sidebar, then iCloud aktivieren. It uses the system iCloud account and CloudKit private/shared databases; no separate synchronization server is operated. Local writing works without this connection. Diagnose exposes bounded version/status/error information without manuscript or account contents. Build 13 corrects reproduced durable transport-file capacity failures for extensive revision histories and batches exact-revision receipts while retaining newer local edits.

AI is optional. Apple Private Cloud Compute, OpenAI/Anthropic API keys and ChatGPT sign-in depend on provider/device/account/region eligibility. No AI account is required for writing or export. Planned AI work requires explicit activation and uses the selected access and supported execution conditions; successful execution is not promised when those conditions are unavailable.

Build 13 replaces build 10 with refined native paper/inspector/toolbar UI, templates and writing tools, local task access, safe iCloud diagnostics and transport-capacity corrections. No advertising or tracking SDK. Experimental native multilingual rule-engine research is excluded.
iOSWhatsNewDE:
Verbesserungen für Schreiben und iCloud:
• Spaces öffnet zuerst die Seitenübersicht.
• iCloud ist über das Wolkensymbol und im Text über „Mehr“ direkt erreichbar.
• Verbesserte Synchronisation umfangreicher Fassungshistorien und genauere, teilbare Fehlerdiagnose.
Deine lokalen Texte bleiben auch ohne iCloud oder KI-Zugang verfügbar.
iOSWhatsNewEN:
Writing and iCloud improvements:
• Spaces opens the page list first.
• iCloud is directly available from the cloud toolbar and the editor’s More menu.
• Improved synchronization of extensive revision histories and more precise, shareable diagnostics.
Your local texts remain available without iCloud or AI access.
